races.title: Join The Southwell Racecourse Corporate Club Handicap Chase
races.verdict: IMPERIAL BEDE has plummeted to a career-low mark after a quiet spell and the cheekpieces he wore for the first time when last successful are back on. He's interesting for an in-form stable, all the more so if there is strength behind him in the betting. Grain Trade should stay this far and is a player, while last year's winner Bravethewaves could be a force in new headgear. IMPERIAL BEDE (FR) GRAIN TRADE BRAVETHEWAVES

races.title: Dance Through The Decades Christmas Parties Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: SLEDGEHAMMER had a next-time-out winner behind him at Wetherby and is taken to defy the handicapper again and make it 3-3 since joining Adrian Keatley. Bells of Ufford made a promising start to his chasing career at Ffos Las and is second choice ahead of Kastellion and Could Be You . SLEDGEHAMMER (IRE) BELLS OF UFFORD (IRE) KASTELLION (FR)

races.title: Winter Ladies Night Saturday 28th November Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: BEAU DE MAINE showed plenty - behind one who's since run well over hurdles - in a Market Rasen bumper on his debut last month, so he's an appealing candidate making a quick switch to jumping for a yard that continues in fine fettle. Popton Point won 2 of her 3 starts in the bumper sphere last season, impressing with her attitude, and is surely up to making her presence felt on her hurdling debut, while Uda Man Dan is an interesting newcomer given his useful Flat pedigree. BEAU DE MAINE (FR) POPTON POINT (IRE) UDA MAN DAN (GER)

races.title: Festive Fixtures At Southwell Racecourse Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: NOBODY TOLD ME is selected to make a winning start for new trainer Dan Skelton, with confidence in his chance increased should the betting vibes be strong. Yourcardismarked has also been the subject of an interesting trainer change and support for him would make him a potentially dangerous opponent. Laplander should be up to doing something off this mark based on Flat ability, while it would also be no surprise were Cheap Sandwiches to prove a different proposition in handicaps. NOBODY TOLD ME YOURCARDISMARKED (IRE) LAPLANDER

races.title: Christmas Jumper Day Sunday 13th December Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: IN THE PURPLE hasn't been seen since a C&D handicap success in February but he took that in the style of one who should have more to offer for a leading stable. The Boss Bear couldn't justify favouritism but still made a sound start for the James Owen yard at Plumpton 3 weeks ago and heads the many possible dangers along with Presenting Milan and Dan Skelton's Typhoon Warrior , who is bred to be suited by this longer trip. IN THE PURPLE (IRE) THE BOSS BEAR (IRE) PRESENTING MILAN (IRE)

races.title: Book The Bistro In Seasons Restaurant Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: GIMARIAS is the obvious one on the back of his good second to a progressive sort at Chepstow at the beginning of the month. The fact that The Brave Guy went off as short as 5/2 in a competitive race on his handicap debut suggests he's thought better than he showed on that occasion. The low-mileage Elusive Shine is one to monitor closely in the betting on his return from an absence for in-form Sam England. GIMARIAS (IRE) THE BRAVE GUY (IRE) ELUSIVE SHINE (IRE)
